confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living web search results (MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables, and PacificPrime, which cites Numbeo). The sources do not fully agree, and some of the data may be from 2023. Midpoints were used and lightly adjusted for mid-2026. The mid-range meal for two was raised above the roughly $25–27 that sources report, to reflect a real three-course meal. Cocktail and wine prices were not searched directly. They are estimated from how they usually compare with beer in Taiwan's bar scene, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only, not from live booking pages. They assume July is summer high season in a popular domestic tourist city. The FX rate is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 Nov 2026, as given in a search result summary that names rba.gov.au pages. I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan is a mid-sized southern Taiwanese city. Prices are similar to Kaohsiung and Taichung and generally a bit below Taipei, especially for street food and budget lodging.
